tasks.short: Write the manual and the workbook.

steps.what: Draft manual sections from headings in the production materials.

loop.purpose: Bind each manual section to a heading in the production material.
loop.input: The production materials the company already holds.
loop.output: Draft sections that cite those headings and add no step.
loop.check: Each section cites a heading id and states only a step that heading states.
loop.stop: No heading id, or the section states a step the material does not.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed chapter list cannot tell which step is not in the production material.

steps.what: Develop manuals, texts, and workbooks in conjunction with the production materials.
File the accepted texts and the related training workbook.

tasks.design: A draft in {DOCS} builds manual sections only from headings in the production materials, and it stops when a section states a step the material does not. The audio technician develops the manuals, texts, and workbooks for training, in conjunction with those materials. The accepted text is filed only after that edit, for that version. The draft is not the manual. Materials with no headings are not drafted.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manual was written from memory of the production, and a step in the workbook no longer matched the material.
tasks.enabler_now: Sections can be drafted from headings the material already has. The technician still writes the manual.
tasks.still_hard: A heading does not say how to teach the step, or which warning the trainee needs.
tasks.human_edge: The technician develops the manual and the workbook. The draft only repeats steps the production material already states.
tasks.altitude: The technician still writes the manual and the training workbook. A section is filed only after the technician has checked it against the production material.

reach.task: Write the drill from the session that is actually run.
reach.learn: A heading is not the instruction.

evidence.claim: A draft can repeat a step that already appears under a heading in the production material. It cannot add a step the material does not state.
The manual and the workbook are the text the technician edits and accepts. The draft section is not that text.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An audio and video technician in a mid-size European company. A stored equipment id is not a repair, and a draft is not the show.

Fields: The production material id and the heading id. A section with no heading id is not drafted. Training wording that is not in the material is written by the technician. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the audio technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Read the production materials from the document store before adding a new manual file.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the audio technician.
unknowns: Whether training workbooks are owned by this technician or by a learning team.
research_questions: Who accepts a manual before trainees may rely on it?

already_counted.description: Developing the manual, the text, and the workbook stays with the technician.

incremental.description: Retire manual sections whose production material has been replaced.

approvals.approved_version: manual version and the heading ids it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still develops the manual and the training workbook and still accepts the version that is filed. The draft removes only sections whose steps are already under a heading in the production material. Materials with no headings save nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The technician still writes the manual and the training text. A draft may repeat steps that are already in the production material, and it is not the manual.
reach: Coaches and scouts write a drill sheet from what the session actually does, and this job learns a heading is not the instruction.
Poets, lyricists and creative writers edit a draft against the source, and this job learns the production material is the source.
skills_to_grow: Edit the manual so every step cites the production material.
Refuse a training chapter that states a step the material does not.
role.ambitious_version: Manuals and workbooks are filed only after the technician has edited them against the production material. A draft heading is not the instruction.
